source: Background facts copied verbatim from https://www.trueleansolutions.com/about-us/ (Advisors section), retrieved 2026-10-31 (D-38). The sentences about each person's role were rewritten at the company's direction to describe Tech Transpire's work (D-40, draft for approval); no new facts were added. On 2026-11-01 every profile was reframed around consulting with no technology content (D-44, D-45); Dr. Potts's facts come from the resume and bio sheet he supplied. Only the advisors ticked by the company are included (not Nirav Kambodi or Mayank Pujara).
title: Guidance from experienced leaders.
lead: Experienced leaders who guide our strategy and help us deliver greater value to our clients.

advisors.name: Dr. Wally Potts, Ed.D, MBA, PMP
bio: Dr. Potts advises and mentors Tech Transpire on operational turnaround and enterprise transformation. He helps shape how engagements move from deep discovery to an execution blueprint that leadership can commit to, and how organizations stay aligned once execution begins.

An operating executive for more than 15 years across Fortune 50, federal, healthcare and private equity-backed organizations, he works the way we do: assess quickly, find the constraint holding the business back, and put in place the operating model, governance and accountability needed to fix it. He holds a Doctor of Education in Organizational Change and Learning from Baylor University.

His results include $140M+ in savings, $80M of it within the first 90 days, through process improvement and performance management while leading a $472M enterprise services portfolio, and organizational change across 6,000+ employees and contractors. At Veterans Engineering he grew the backlog from $6M to $170M+ and led the M&A execution, from due diligence to integration planning, that resulted in its sale to Aretum.

advisors.name: Sanket Thakkar
bio: Sanket advises Tech Transpire on growth strategy and market expansion, bringing a builder's view of what it takes to turn a validated plan into delivery that scales.

A serial entrepreneur with over 13 years of building and scaling ventures, he is a CEO and co-founder who has grown a team of 100+ serving clients in fintech, manufacturing and high-growth startups globally. He brings deep expertise in business growth and pod-based delivery models.

advisors.name: Ketul Thakker
bio: Ketul advises and mentors the CEO of Tech Transpire on market positioning, marketing communications and campaign development. He helps translate the firm's approach, clarity before change and confidence through execution, into clear messages for leaders at high-stakes transformation points.

He refines messaging, guides campaign design, and keeps marketing activity aligned with business development priorities, bringing focus and consistency to how Tech Transpire presents its work and pursues growth.

advisors.name: Saurabh Kumar
bio: Saurabh advises the CEO of Tech Transpire on assessing new opportunities with discipline. He helps clients separate real opportunity from hype before they commit to a direction, and reviews engagements hands-on where a decision carries real risk.

An executive with 25+ years of experience, Saurabh was most recently a Director at Samsung Research America, where he led a 25-person global team, represented the company at board level in industry foundations, led company-wide evaluations of emerging approaches and briefed senior leadership on adoption decisions.
He has delivered for some of the world's largest consumer electronics companies, including Hisense, Vizio, Lenovo and TPVision, and runs his own consultancy, Wanderlight Creative Group.

advisors.name: Dharmendra Mistry
bio: Dharmendra advises Tech Transpire on healthcare operations and client delivery. He helps healthcare clients uncover the gaps between clinical teams, processes and operations, so the real problem is defined and agreed before change begins.

A healthcare executive with more than 30 years of experience, he built Biomet India from inception to about $10 million in four years, led the Zimmer Biomet integration in India, and headed Lumenis across India and South Asia. As co-founder of Valiant Care, he built and ran a 24/7 care service for seafarers, giving him first-hand experience of how clinical workflows really run.
